Card Q&A.a: No. This card is placed in your trash before the effect can activate. It’s no longer in your battle area, so it doesn't activate.
Card Q&A.q: A Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards and an opponent’s Digimon are deleted simultaneously. Does this card’s inherited effect activate?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon are deleted, gain 1 memory.
